texts: The lion in his palace need not roar; majesty speaks loudest when it keeps quiet.
Could you write a doha about the lion who needs no roar to be feared, and the wise person in a royal palace who says little yet is heard more clearly than a hundred who chatter without pause?
At the palace wedding the quietest guest, a lean old man who looked like a lion, turned out to be the one the king asked for advice.
doha on speaking less, like a lion in a palace who doesn't need to roar
palace, lion, quiet
my mouth gets me in trouble all the time, doha on keeping quiet?

I'd like a doha that says a word once spoken can never be returned to the mouth, so the wise man pauses before he speaks, and the one who keeps his lips closed rarely has anything to regret afterwards.
A word once loosed never returns to its owner; blessed is he who keeps his lips closed until the right hour.
I told my friend's secret at a party last week, and no apology has been able to take it back.
think before speaking
doha on thorn and silence, hurting words stay stuck
A thorn of a careless remark from my teacher stuck in me for twenty years, and I want to remember to say little myself.
A word is a thorn that cannot be plucked from the heart; speak little, and spare the garden.

Please compose a doha that tells how a hurtful word goes in like a thorn and remains lodged forever, so the person who holds his peace and chooses his words carefully spares everyone a lifetime of pain.
thorn, say less

I would like a doha on how a person who talks endlessly gives away all he knows and understands nothing, while the quiet listener quietly gathers wisdom from everyone around him and ends up the wisest in the room.
At our family meeting my grandfather said nothing for two hours and then spoke one sentence that settled everything.
speak less, hear more
The one who talks without pause pours out all he has; the quiet one gathers what the world pours into him.
doha on listening more than talking
My manager never fills a pause in a meeting, and people end up telling him everything, which seems to be his secret strength.
Looking for a couplet saying that the wise do not rush to fill every gap in conversation, because a calm pause shows more strength than a flood of words, and the one who waits is rarely wrong.
power of pauses
doha on being comfortable with quiet moments
In the pause between two words, the whole mind of the wise is heard.
Our cook, who never speaks, catches more fish at the lake than the loud boys who scare them all away.
The fish is caught by the one who waits without a ripple; so is wisdom taken by the still.
doha with fish: quiet ppl catch more
fish, patient quiet
Please make a doha showing that the fisherman who sits without a sound brings back a full catch, and the person who stays calm and says little gathers insights that the loud ones scare away.
doha: philosopher's stone but its quiet, not showy
Everyone in our village says the old hermit has found a philosopher's stone because he says almost nothing yet his presence heals people.
The philosopher's stone makes no sound as it transforms; so the quiet soul transforms all it touches.

Compose a doha showing that the philosopher's stone changes iron to treasure without a single word, just as a person of deep inner calm changes the lives of others by silent example rather than by long speeches.
philosopher's stone, quiet power
At the bridge today two men were shouting at each other, and the old lion-faced watchman said nothing and the fight dissolved.
doha abt a bridge and lion where the silent one wins
I want a doha about a lion who crosses a bridge without roaring and still makes all the others step aside, to show that quiet strength needs no loud announcement and everyone feels it anyway.
The lion crosses the bridge with no roar, and the whole crowd makes way.
bridge, lion, quiet
The boat glides over water without a sound, and the palace is built by those who speak least.

Could you write a doha about how a boat slips across the water without any noise and carries its passengers safely to the shore, much as a person of few words reaches the royal palace of wisdom without exhausting himself?
On the boat to the palace fort last summer, the old boatman spoke just one sentence in two hours, and it was the wisest thing I heard.
boat, palace, few words
doha on a boat and a palace, speaking less
doha with a diamond and lion for being quiet
The diamond does not boast of its sparkle, the lion does not announce his strength; both are known by being still.
Looking for a verse saying a diamond does not shout about its worth and a lion does not announce his strength, and the wise person too speaks little but is recognised by his quiet presence.
diamond, lion, restraint
My father, who looks like a lion, owns a diamond ring but has never spoken of either, and everyone respects him for it.

Compose a doha about a person who looks into a mirror and realises how much he talks about himself, then decides to keep quiet at the bier of a friend, where words are useless and presence is everything.
doha on standing quietly at a bier, mirror of ur own words
bier, mirror, no words
At the bier all words fall silent; in the mirror of death I see the poverty of my talking.
At my friend's bier I could say nothing at all, and looking at myself in the mirror later I understood that quiet is sometimes the only honest answer.

Please write me a doha comparing a person of few words to sandalwood, which gives its fragrance quietly without speaking and cools everyone near it, while loud talkers give only noise and exhaustion to those around.
sandalwood, few words
doha about being like sandalwood, quiet but fragrant
Sandalwood speaks no word yet perfumes the air; so let me say little and leave a fragrance.
The sandalwood trader in our lane says almost nothing, yet his quiet manner draws more customers than all the shouting around him.
doha w diamond n traveler, travellers should keep their mouth shut about their wealth
diamond, traveler, discretion
My friend the traveler wears a diamond in his pocket but tells nobody, and so he moves safely through any town.
I'd like a doha for a traveler who wisely keeps his mouth shut about the diamond he carries, because loose talk invites trouble, and whoever guards his words guards his life and his belongings too.
The traveler who carries a diamond and a quiet mouth passes every danger; boasting is the bandit of the road.
The grindstone grinds loudly and gives only flour; the silent saint grinds his ego and is a feast for all.
grindstone, calm, quiet mind
My grandmother turns the grindstone each dawn without a word, and somehow that hour of silence is the most peaceful of her day.

Please write a doha explaining that the grindstone works ceaselessly without speaking, producing what feeds a family, just as a person who works in quiet focus achieves more than one who talks about his plans all day.
doha about silent work at a grindstone
doha w a well and fish about silent depth
The well is deep and does not splash; the fish within lives quiet, and both are the richer for it.
The old men sitting near the well hardly talk, like the fish below them who live their whole life in silent water, and they seem happier than all of us.
well, fish, quiet depth
Compose a doha showing that a deep well makes no sound while the shallow water at its edge splashes loudly, and so a profound person speaks little while the shallow-minded talk and boast without end.
The palanquin passes through the village without a word, and every eye follows it in reverence.

Could you write a doha about a bride carried in a palanquin who says nothing on her way to her new life, yet speaks volumes by her calm dignity, showing that quiet bearing is more eloquent than any speech?
palanquin, hush
My sister rode in her palanquin on the wedding day without uttering a word, and the dignity of her quiet made everyone in the street fall silent too.
doha on a bride in a palanquin, quiet and dignified
doha on shutting up sometimes, long day lol
I said something sharp to my husband and then watched his face change; I wish I had been quiet for just ten seconds.
hold your words
The unsaid sentence never wounds; the wise keep their cruelest thoughts safely in the dark.

Please write a doha about how a moment of silence before answering an insult can save a lifetime of grief, because the word held back today never has to be explained, apologised for or mourned tomorrow.
The stone is mute, and yet pilgrims bow to it; a quiet soul commands more reverence than a loud sermon.
doha on stone being silent and wise

I want a doha about how a stone says nothing for centuries and yet remains unmoved by every storm, so the one who learns to keep his counsel becomes equally steady and strong against every kind of attack.
stone, quiet strength
Whenever I want to react to my sister's remarks I sit near the big stone in the yard until the words in me settle, and it has saved our relationship.
Salt melts without a murmur and flavours every dish, and the mirror says nothing yet shows all; so let me say little and reveal much.

Could you compose a doha about how salt gives taste to every meal without announcing itself and a mirror reveals the truth without uttering a word, showing that quiet presence teaches more than loud advice?
doha on salt and mirror, silent but powerful
salt, mirror, wordless truth
My teacher never lectured us, but one look from her was like a mirror, and her quiet presence added flavour to the class like salt in a meal.
pearl, musk deer, hush
doha on how true treasure is quiet like a pearl or a musk deer's scent
The pearl sleeps in silence, the musk deer carries its fragrance without a word; true worth is never loud.

Compose a doha showing that the pearl lies hidden in its shell without calling attention to itself and the musk deer carries its perfume unspoken, and that the best qualities of a person also need no advertisement.
The musk deer I saw at the sanctuary walked without a sound, and its owner kept a pearl in his drawer that he never mentioned to anyone.
The stone does not speak, the snake does not hiss when it is wise; the quiet ones are the most dangerous and the most safe.
doha abt stone and snake, silent dangerous/wise

I'd like a doha showing that a stone says nothing and a snake strikes only when needed, and likewise a wise man speaks little and acts only at the right time, never wasting breath or energy on idle noise.
My grandfather is like a snake coiled on a stone in the warmth: silent, calm, and when he speaks the whole room pays attention.
stone, snake, few words
My daughter asked why I never argue with her uncle, and I said some battles are best won by not speaking at all.
quiet wins
doha on winning arguments by not having them
The one who answers not the insult wins the war without drawing a single breath of rage.
Please write a doha explaining that arguing with a fool only makes two fools, and the person who keeps his peace and walks away wins without having said a single word he will later regret.
hold your peace
Where words are many, wisdom is thin; the wise man's quiet is a full harvest.
At the funeral, when everyone offered long speeches, the only comfort I felt came from a neighbour who simply sat beside me.
Write a doha showing that those who have the most to say are often the least understood and that the quiet person who listens attentively is the one whom others trust with their deepest secrets.
doha for when u dont know what to say, just be quiet
The date palm stands tall and never boasts of its fruit; the quiet are sweetest when the season turns.
doha with a date palm about modesty and quiet
The date palm in our compound never makes a sound, yet children wait for its fruit every year; my father is the same, quiet and generous.

Compose a doha showing that a date palm gives fruit year after year without any announcement, and the quiet one who does his duty without boasting is respected far more than someone who talks of his achievements.
date palm, quiet worth
well, lotus, still mind
The lotus blooms silent above muddy water and the deep well holds its secrets; both teach the stillness of a quiet mind.
doha on a well and a lotus - quiet and calm
In our courtyard the old well and the lotus basin are the quietest corners, and I go there whenever the family noise becomes too much.
Looking for a doha showing that the lotus blossoms without a sound and a deep well keeps its water still, so too the wise person remains calm and quiet while the world around splashes in noise.
Let my lips rest, for in quiet hours the soul hears what the noisy day drowns out.
precious quiet
After a week of arguing with everyone, I spent a day without speaking and felt more rested than I had in years.
Please write a doha telling that periods of quiet restore the mind, and that a person who sets aside some hours each day to speak to nobody finds clarity that no conversation could ever give.
doha on taking a day of not talking, so refreshing
doha on sandalwood being silent but fragrant
Sandalwood asks nothing and says nothing, yet all who pass are perfumed; let my quiet be such a gift.
Could you write a doha about how a person of few words resembles sandalwood, whose goodness is felt rather than heard, and who leaves a lasting fragrance in the memory of everyone who meets him?
sandalwood, quiet goodness
Our neighbour, a sandalwood carver, hardly talks, but when he is gone from the lane the whole place feels emptier.
doha pls: say less, mean more
few words, deep meaning
My boss's emails are two lines long and everyone treats them as law, while my long messages get ignored.
Few are the words of the wise, and each one carries the weight of a hundred.
I'd like a doha showing that short, thoughtful speech carries far more weight than long, rambling talk, because the wise know that every unnecessary word weakens the one that truly matters.
Write a doha about how at the cremation ground all talk of rank and wealth stops and everyone stands quiet, teaching us that we should learn to hold our words and ego in check while we still live.
cremation ground, hush
At the cremation ground the loudest voices fall quiet; learn now what that place will teach you later.
Walking past the cremation ground with my father, we both stopped talking, and for the first time I understood why he speaks so little.
doha about the hush at the cremation ground
sun, rising quietly
The sun came up this morning without a sound and I realised my loud, restless mind could learn something from it.
The sun climbs the sky without announcing itself; all the world is warmed by its quiet rising.

I want a doha comparing a person of few words to the sun, which rises every day without a sound and lights up the world, while the loud one is like thunder that frightens and then fades without giving anything.
doha on sun being quiet yet powerful, like a calm person
doha on not oversharing with ppl, learned the hard way
I told my colleague about my salary plans and now the whole office knows; I wish I had simply kept quiet.
Compose a doha showing that a secret told to one person is no longer a secret, so the wise keep their plans and troubles to themselves, and only speak when speaking can truly help someone.
keep your secrets
What the lips guard remains yours; what the lips release belongs to the wind.
quiet is precious
doha on how not talking is sometimes the best answer
Between two storms of speech, the quiet one finds a calm and shelters others there.
Please write a doha explaining that in a quarrel the person who stays calm and speaks little is the one who in the end is believed and respected by everyone who was watching from outside.
My two aunts have not spoken in ten years, and the one who stayed quiet during the fight is the one everyone still visits.
The blacksmith's furnace roars all day, yet the old smith himself says nothing, and I always leave his workshop feeling calmer.
furnace, restraint
The furnace roars and the smith stays silent; the loudest work is done by the quietest hands.

Looking for a doha about the furnace that roars and glows while the master craftsman beside it says nothing, to show that real skill needs no announcement and that the quiet worker is the one most trusted.
doha w furnace: noisy work, quiet master

Could you write a doha saying that a tree gives shade and fruit without a word and a house built on quiet values endures for generations, while a house of constant shouting falls apart despite strong walls?
The tree speaks not, yet shelters all; the house of quiet folk stands long.
tree, house, calm
Our house stands beneath an old tree and the quietest member of the family, my grandmother, holds everything together.
doha on a tree and a house, quiet families last

Please write a doha about the furnace of the mind, where hasty words are forged into weapons, and the person who cools his thoughts in quiet before speaking never makes a blade that will later turn against himself.
doha on furnace of the mind, think before talking
furnace, cooled words
In the furnace of the mind let the words cool before they are spoken, lest they scald the listener.
I wrote an angry email in a furnace-hot mood and saved it as draft overnight, and by morning I was glad I never sent it.
When the sun is highest, even the village dogs go quiet in the shade, and I wish people would take the same lesson at noon arguments.
sun, hush

Compose a doha showing that at noon under a fierce sun all creatures fall quiet and rest, and that people too should learn to cease their noise in the heat of anger and wait for the evening to cool them.
Under the high sun all creatures are still; so the wise hush in the burning hour of anger.
doha on keeping quiet in the middle of a fight, sun as image

Could you write a doha that says the mouth is a gateway through which both blessings and curses leave, and so the wise keep it mostly closed, opening it only when what they have to say improves upon silence itself?
Speak only if your word is better than the hush; otherwise let the hush speak for you.
My grandmother used to say that if my words were not kinder than the quiet, I should save them, and I follow it every day.
improve upon quiet
doha on only talking when it helps
I'd like a doha about my father who spoke very little through his life yet whose few words were always remembered, so that now I try to do the same and speak only when the moment truly asks for it.
My late father rarely said more than ten words a day, yet each of them has stayed with me for years.
doha for dad, a man of few words
man of few words
He said little, and what he said stayed; his quiet was a legacy.
The mouth that opens less learns more; the still mind catches the whisper of truth that the shouting world misses.
Could you write a doha saying that the quiet student learns more than the clever talker, because the one who is always speaking never has room to listen, and the truth speaks in a very soft voice?
doha on learning by listening instead of talking
listen, don't talk
In class I used to answer every question first, but the quiet girl beside me topped the exams, and I wonder what she knew that I did not.
doha on bite ur lip when someone provokes u
Between the taunt and the reply lies a small, calm space; the wise live in it.
When my brother-in-law taunted me at the wedding, I smiled and kept quiet, and by evening everyone knew who the better person was.
Please write a doha showing that the best reply to an insult is often no reply at all, because the one who answers in calm quiet stands taller than the one who spoke in anger.
silent reply
speak when needed
There is a time for the word and a time for the hush; blessed is he who knows the hour of each.
doha on knowing when to talk and when to shut up
My teacher knew exactly when to speak and when to let us think in the quiet, and that rhythm made her the best I ever had.
I would like a doha about how a wise person knows the right moment to speak and the right moment to stay quiet, since a true word at the wrong time can do as much harm as a lie.
thread of quiet
doha on stitching up ur mouth with a thread lol
Could you write a doha about how a thread binds a torn garment without any sound and a person who knows when to close his mouth can hold a whole family together in the same way?
My mother mends our torn garments with a single thread each evening without saying a word, and the whole family feels held by her quiet.
The thread mends without a murmur; so a quiet soul sews up what loud ones tear.
pearl, hidden quiet
The pearl forms in darkness without a sound; the best work of the soul too is done in hush.
My friend, a pearl diver's daughter, talks little and works long, and her quiet life shines in a way that loud ones never do.
Compose a doha showing that a pearl is formed in silence and darkness and is revealed only at the right time, just like true wisdom, which grows inside a quiet person and is never shouted aloud.
doha on how pearls grow quietly, like wisdom
Please write a doha about how the tongue is a small organ that can do more harm than any weapon and more good than a feast, so the wise keep it controlled and speak seldom and with care.
doha on how the tongue can ruin you if u let it
My tongue has gotten me fired twice, and now I am learning to hold back in meetings and let others talk first.
Small is the tongue yet it rules the whole body; blessed is the one who keeps it in the quiet.
control the tongue
bee, quiet work
The bee in my garden works all day in silence, while the neighbours chatter over the fence and get nothing done.

Please write a doha about the bee, which gathers nectar quietly from flower to flower and produces what sweetens the whole world, showing that the person who works silently produces more than the one who talks loudly.
The bee hums only a little and fills the hive with sweetness; the noisy are quick to chatter and slow to build.
doha on a bee and quiet hard work
doha on a blind man who hears more because he talks less, and a musk deer
A blind man in our lane says little but hears everything, like the musk deer that carries its scent without ever knowing it.
The blind man listens and the musk deer carries its scent unknowing; both are rich in quiet.

Compose a doha showing that a blind man who speaks little hears the whole world through his listening, and a musk deer carries its precious perfume without announcing it, teaching us the worth of a quiet and attentive life.
blind man, musk deer, listening
doha on being chill and not saying every thought out loud

Please write a doha explaining that not every thought needs to be spoken and not every opinion needs to be shared, because a calm mind keeps many things to itself and thereby keeps the peace of the whole group.
unspoken thoughts
Many thoughts are born in the mind; the wise let most of them die there, unspoken, and all are better for it.
I wanted to tell my aunt exactly what I thought about her new rules, but I held back and the visit was lovely.
Could you write a doha about the wise old person who sits in the corner of the room during a heated discussion, says nothing until the end, and then offers one calm sentence that resolves everything?
doha on the quiet elder who solves arguments with one line
After the storm of voices, one soft sentence from the quiet elder settles all.
elder's few words
In every family dispute my great-uncle waits until everyone is tired, then says one small thing, and the matter is closed.
doha on how fire gets louder when u fuel it, ignoring a fight puts it out
Looking for a doha showing that a quarrel is like a fire that dies when it is not fed with more words, and the person who stays quiet in the face of provocation puts it out before it can grow.
My sister kept replying to the online abuse and it only grew into a blaze; I told her to stop typing, and soon it died away.
fire, starve of words
A fire dies when no fuel is added; so does a quarrel when no word is offered back.
My uncle sits beneath the tree with his bitter gourd tea, saying nothing, and the whole yard feels at peace.
doha on a tree, bitter gourd and quiet, the calm of old people

Looking for a doha about the old tree that gives shade without a word, and the bitter gourd that offers its bitterness without complaint, showing how an elder who suffers and endures in silence becomes a blessing to all.
tree, bitter gourd, quiet
The tree gives shade, the bitter gourd gives its medicine, and neither utters a word of its worth.
